messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Spike in 5xx and client timeouts on /v1/generate (hosted-us-east-1) detected at 03:14 UTC. Incident INC-2390000007. Pager sent to rotation. Please ACK and join war room: https://meet.redwood-internal.com/warroom/INC-2390000007 (pw: redwood-2390)
aisha: acked. i'm oncall; joining war room and pulling error histograms.
tom: ack. looking at routing and cache invalidation logs. tagging @infra for host-level checks.
greg: I'm in. initial glance: sudden uptick in cache-miss rates on KV cache layer starting at 03:11, coincident with a config push from the control plane.
ops-lead: assigning incident owner to @aisha for triage and comms. @greg take infra lead to validate cache host health. severity set to Sev2 (partial degradation).
aisha: quick summary: 5xx rose from 0.2% -> ~9% in 3m. Affected paths: text generation and streaming endpoints. Error traces reference "kvcache: miss and rebuild" and heavy CPU on cache nodes.
deploy-bot: Config push: controlplane/config#554 applied at 03:10 UTC (author: infra/auto-config). Key change: cache-consistency=strict enabled for hosted fleet us-east-1.
greg: confirming host metrics: cache nodes in pool cache-east-1 show high GC and thread contention. No kernel OOMs. Some cache rebuild jobs spawned concurrently.
infra: mitigation idea: disable strict consistency flag to allow relaxed reads, and drain immediate rebuilds. we can also temporarily offload heavy prefixes to fallback pool.
ops-lead: plan: 1) revert config flag 2) drain ongoing cache-rebuild jobs 3) apply emergency traffic reroute for noisy prefixes 4) update status page and support channel.
aisha: executing revert (running command):
```
redwoodctl config set --key cache-consistency --value relaxed --scope region=us-east-1 --change-id CFG-2390-revert
```

deploy-bot: Config change queued: CFG-2390-revert. Expected propagation ~30s.
greg: also throttling cache rebuild worker concurrency on cache hosts to reduce CPU churn:
```
redwoodctl workers set --pool cache-east-1 --worker rebuild --concurrency 2
```

infra: creating temporary route for heavy prefixes (selector client_tag=long-prompts) to fallback pool in us-west-2:
```
redwoodctl route temporary --selector "client_tag=long-prompts" --to us-west-2 --duration 20m --reason "mitigate cache rebuild spike"
```

aisha: status page draft (public):
"We are investigating increased errors and timeouts for the Redwood Hosted API in us-east-1. Engineers identified a recent config change that caused excessive cache rebuilds and increased error rates. Mitigations including reverting the config and routing affected traffic to a fallback pool are in progress. Updates every 20 minutes. Initial detection 03:14 UTC."

ops-lead: set status to "Partial outage" for Hosted API us-east-1. Please include detection time. Keep update cadence at 20m.
support-lead: internal support blurb to triage teams:
"We are investigating higher error rates for text generation in us-east-1 caused by cache rebuild storms after a config change. Engineering has reverted the config and is offloading affected prefixes. If you have customers reporting issues, open a P1 ticket referencing INC-2390000007 and link the war room. We'll follow up with customer-facing notes after stabilization."

aisha: paging confirmations: @aisha ack, @tom ack, @greg ack, @infra ack. backup oncall: @mike (not paged) standby.

greg: revert propagated. cache rebuild spawn rate dropped ~65% within 45s. CPU on cache nodes trending down. 5xx down to 2.8% current.

aisha: applying temporary client prefix block for the heaviest noisy client to prevent immediate rebuild pressure while we watch:
```
redwoodctl traffic block --region us-east-1 --prefix client-longprompt-7 --duration 15m --reason "temp mitigation for cache rebuilds"
```

aisha: notifying CS to expect degraded delivery for that single client and to escalate if revenue-impacting. support-lead: can you message the enterprise owner?
support-lead: yes, sending tailored note to the single affected enterprise customer: short blurb + status link + war room contact.
ops-lead: confirm rollout pause for any new config pushes to hosted fleets in us-east-1 until incident cleared.

infra: running host-level smoothing on cache nodes and reducing background IO:
```
redwoodctl host set --pool cache-east-1 --background-io low
```

aisha: monitoring: sustained error rate under 1.5% for the last 2 minutes. p99 latency improving. holding for 10m sustained before de-escalation.
tom: note to include in postmortem: control plane didn't respect staged rollout for cache-consistency flag; it hit entire region at once. we'll capture rollout logs and adjust runbook.
ops-lead: post-incident roles: RCA -> @tom, infra timeline and metrics -> @greg, customer comms & postmortem distribution -> @aisha, support follow-ups -> @support-lead. tag incident tracker INC-2390000007.
aisha: drafting timeline and will create the initial incident doc; thanks all for fast responses.
incident-bot: Incident update: Config revert and prefix mitigation applied. Monitoring recovery. Next automated check-in in 20 minutes. Channel will archive after resolution.
